column3: “To the face of length” is rendered “Along the length,” and “entrance” as “door.”
“A way of one cubit” follows the Hebrew; NASB has “one hundred cubits,” following the LXX.
“The one bringing” follows the written text; NASB has “the entrance.”
The end of the verse is difficult; the meaning is uncertain.
“Five hundred reeds” follows the Hebrew; the LXX has “cubits.”
